title: The two records cut at the hall and lost from the car
summary: His band cut two numbers on a home recording machine, and the only copies were stolen from his car seat.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Is that just to take the picture, I guess? You stood over there. Oh, yeah. I had a gang of pictures. We gave them all away. I had cut two records.

One night at the. At the hall I was playing. We cut two numbers. We cut. St. Louis Blues that night. And. My Desire. That's my desire. My Desire just came out. And we was playing it. Well, the fella got his recording. He had a beautiful recording machine. He stood up there in the hall and cut them.
Well, I forgot to ask. When this. When. Was this band picture taken? About when?
This band picture was taken around in 1927.
1927? Yeah. Around 1927. Is that about when they made the records? Or were the records made later?

No. All the records was made around in about 1930. The records was made. Around in 1930. We cut those records. And I taken the two records. And I put them on my seat at automobile. And I went in the corner. Willie Pazio was playing trumpet. And. He's a very good trumpet player. Also. Willie Pazio was playing trumpet. And. I went. Over. In. He's a friend's house. To talk. We went in there to talk. And chat a little while. And when I come out there. Then took the two records off the seat. I didn't lock the car.
Somebody taking them. They taking the two records.
I thought you were going to say. Somebody sat on them. And broke them. No.
They taking them. Somebody taking them out the car. They were sitting right on the seat. Just right. Just like that tray is there.
That was the only two copies.
That was the only two copies I had.
Yeah. We'd never find them now. Nobody.
Was there more made. Was that the only two made. Or was there more made.
Made on a home recorder. Yeah. A home recorder. Just one copy.
Just a home recorder. Just one copy then. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. One copy. Played both sides. Yeah. Yeah.
